text:
You are diagnosing a reported bug. If a reference (log, stack trace, repro steps) is attached, read it and reproduce the failure before writing a fix — do not guess at root cause from the description alone. If nothing is attached, reproduce it yourself first.

Goal: General Enhancmenets

These are small change on the app in various places, no major work. 

(1) The highlight of the current tab is not sufficient, Home's tile should be more pronounced and the current active tab should have complete surround border highlight to leave no doubt what is the current selection; 

More to come lets get this one going

Typecheck passes. Summary: Home pill and the active project tab in `TabBar.tsx` now get a full `border-accent` surround (all four sides, previously just top/left/right border-line or an inset-shadow-only for Home) plus the inset accent shadow retained, and Home's active label is now `font-semibold` for extra prominence. Ready for more items whenever you have them.
Only one tab can be selected at any time. The HOME-tab itself should have distinct look-feel vs. the Project tabs that come after. Home-tab is fixed as the most left-one

This looks good — Home now reads as a distinct rounded-full "beacon" pill (filled solid `bg-accent` when selected) permanently anchored leftmost, clearly differentiated in shape and fill from the rectangular, top-rounded Project tabs, which keep their outlined `border-accent` surround-highlight for the active selection.

Typecheck passes. Both changes are in `src/renderer/components/TabBar.tsx`, uncommitted — let me know if you'd like these committed, or send the next enhancement.
"Epics"-left-nav-option is visible on the Left-Navigation when "Home"-tab, "Epics" should only be visible under the Project's tab and they are unique to that "Project"'s tab (file-path)

All green. Summary of this change:

- `src/renderer/lib/navGroups.ts`: `terminal` (labeled "Epics" in the sidebar) is now `faces: PROJECT` instead of `faces: BOTH` — it no longer appears in the Left-Nav while on the Home tab, only while a Project tab is active, matching Epics being scoped/unique to that project's file-path. Tweaked its hint text to drop the stale "grouped by project" wording (it's now inherently single-project).
- `src/renderer/lib/__tests__/navGroupsHome.test.ts`: updated the `BOTH`/`PROJECT_ONLY` fixture lists and added a "terminal (Epics) is project-only" test block, following the same pattern already used for `memory`, `repoviz`, etc.

Note: the "Active sessions" widget on the Home screen still has a deep-link (`Home.tsx:454-456`) that can navigate directly to a specific Epic's terminal panel by epic id, bypassing the sidebar. I left that as-is since it's a targeted action on a specific epic, not a general "Epics" nav affordance — flag if you want that closed off too.

Typecheck and the affected unit tests (`navGroupsHome`, `layout`, `EpicsWorkspace` — 44+50 tests) all pass.

The "Home"-tab is missing a tile "Home"-left-nav-item inside it. "Home"'s-tab-left-nav-item must be distict from the "Home"-left-nav item from the "Project"-tab; To avoid Confusion just label it "Dashboard" and the current "Home"'s Project Left-Nav label us "Project Home" thats how I'll reffer to them in future to avoid this silly "Home" repetieion

Summary:

- `src/renderer/lib/navGroups.ts`: added a new `overview` sidebar row (label "Dashboard", `faces: HOME`) that lands on the same `<Home>` screen already reachable via the TabBar's Home chip — it's now also reachable as a Left-Nav tile while on the Home tab. Renamed `project-home`'s label from "Home" to "Project Home" (`faces: PROJECT`, unchanged behavior). Updated the file's stale header comment accordingly.
- No routing/store changes needed: `openPanel('overview')` already sets `navFace: 'home'` and `screenComponents.tsx` already renders `<Home>` for `overview` — the sidebar row was the only missing piece.
- `src/renderer/lib/__tests__/navGroupsHome.test.ts`: updated the "first Workspace item" test to expect `overview`/"Dashboard", added a "project-home is labeled Project Home" check, added `overview` to `HOME_ONLY`, and added a dedicated "overview (Dashboard) is home-only" describe block mirroring existing patterns.

Verified: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint:selectors`, and the 5 affected test files (94 tests) all pass.

Going forward I'll use your naming: **Dashboard** (Home tab's Left-Nav item, `overview`) vs **Project Home** (Project tab's Left-Nav item, `project-home`).
